name: NoticeCraft – Announcement Bar, News Ticker & Floating Notices
author: cresario

sections.description:
Make important messages stand out with NoticeCraft, a visual announcement and notification bar plugin for WordPress. Create promotional banners, scrolling news tickers and floating notices without writing code.

Whether you run an online store, business website, blog or news site, NoticeCraft helps you communicate offers, updates, events and important information to your visitors.

Choose from 90 free template variations, customize your design in a live preview and manage your notices from one WordPress dashboard.

Three notice types in one plugin

Announcement Bar

Display promotional messages, shipping announcements, business updates, seasonal offers or important reminders at the top or bottom of your website. Add an optional label, image and call-to-action button.

Scrolling Ticker

Create a scrolling text marquee or news ticker for headlines, announcements, offers and updates. Enter multiple messages on separate lines, adjust the animation speed and choose continuous scrolling or rotating messages.

Floating Notice

Display a compact notice card in a corner of your website. Use it for special offers, event reminders, service announcements or links to important pages. Customize the card width, placement and appearance.

90 free template variations

  • 30 announcement bar templates.
  • 30 scrolling ticker templates.
  • 30 floating notice templates.
  • Live template gallery with category and search filters.
  • Template categories include Essentials, Promotions, Modern, Editorial and Seasonal.
  • All included templates are available without payment.

Visual customization and live preview

  • Preview your notice in a simulated website layout.
  • Switch between desktop, tablet and mobile preview sizes.
  • Preview against light and dark website backgrounds.
  • Customize background, text and accent colors.
  • Adjust font size, inner padding and corner radius.
  • Add custom messages, labels, button text and destination URLs.
  • Select a logo or image using the WordPress media library.
  • Show or hide optional labels and buttons.
  • Adjust ticker speed and floating notice width.

Display and scheduling controls

  • Position announcement bars and tickers at the top or bottom of the website.
  • Choose from four corner positions for floating notices.
  • Display notices on all devices, desktop only or mobile only.
  • Set optional start and end dates for time-limited announcements.
  • Allow visitors to dismiss notices.
  • Activate or deactivate individual notices.

Manage your notices

Create, edit and delete notices from a dedicated dashboard. View total notices, active notices and available template configurations in one place.

Lightweight frontend

NoticeCraft uses vanilla JavaScript and CSS for frontend presentation, without requiring a frontend JavaScript framework. Active notice data is retrieved from your own WordPress site’s REST API separately from the page HTML to help reduce stale notices on cached pages.

Ideas for using NoticeCraft

  • Promote sales, discounts and seasonal offers.
  • Announce free shipping or delivery information manually.
  • Share important business hours and service updates.
  • Display breaking news and blog announcements.
  • Promote upcoming events and registrations.
  • Highlight new products, services or website content.
  • Direct visitors to contact pages or important resources.

Source Code

All plugin source code is included in this package under the GPLv2 or later license. The PHP files, assets/admin.js, assets/front.js, assets/admin.css and assets/front.css are the editable source files used directly by WordPress. No compilation, bundling, minification, external source repository or build tools are required. The JavaScript uses browser APIs and the WordPress media library.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New and search for NoticeCraft, or upload the plugin ZIP using Upload Plugin.
  2. Install and activate NoticeCraft.
  3. Open NoticeCraft > Create Notice.
  4. Choose Announcement Bar, Scrolling Ticker or Floating Notice.
  5. Select a template and customize its content, appearance and display settings.
  6. Enable Active and click Save notice.
  7. Visit your website to check the result.
sections.faq:
Is NoticeCraft free?

Yes. All three notice types and all 90 included template variations are available without payment in this release.

Do I need coding skills?

No. The visual editor provides controls for content, appearance and display behavior.

Can I create multiple notices?

Yes. Each notice is saved separately and can be activated or deactivated individually.

How do I add multiple ticker messages?

Choose Scrolling Ticker and enter one message per line in the message field.

Can I schedule an announcement?

Yes. Optional start and end dates are available in Behavior & display.

Can I display a notice only on mobile devices?

Yes. Choose Mobile only in the device visibility settings. Desktop only and All devices are also available.

Can visitors close a notice?

Yes. Enable the dismissible option for that notice.

Can I use NoticeCraft on an online store?

Yes, you can create manual promotional notices for your store. Automatic cart-based offers and dynamic coupon integrations are not included in this release.

Does NoticeCraft require a page builder?

No. Notices are managed from the WordPress dashboard and displayed automatically on the frontend.

Does NoticeCraft require an external service?

No external service is required for the built-in notice functionality. The frontend retrieves notice data from your own WordPress REST API.

Why is my notice not appearing?

Check that the notice is active, its schedule and device settings allow it to display, and it has not been dismissed in your current browser session. Also check that your site’s REST API is accessible and that caching or optimization tools are not blocking the frontend script.
